comment: List of known plugins shown on the website (section Known plugins). Add an entry to list a plugin; 'jar' only for the plugins published with Arcana's releases. Plain text only (no HTML).

plugins.name: arcana-plugin-nsis
plugins.description: Extracts the files of NSIS installers (NSIS 2 and 3, ANSI and Unicode, zlib, bzip2 and LZMA, solid or not). Requires Arcana 1.0.2.
plugins.author: Stephane Bury

plugins.name: arcana-plugin-innosetup
plugins.description: Extracts the files of Inno Setup installers (setup data 5.4.2 to 7.x; LZMA, LZMA2, zlib, bzip2; solid or not; setup-1.bin data files; encrypted installers with the password). Requires Arcana 1.0.4.
plugins.author: Stephane Bury

plugins.name: arcana-plugin-installshield
plugins.description: InstallShield cabinet sets (data1.hdr, data1.cab...) and the files embedded in InstallShield setup.exe launchers. Requires Arcana 1.0.4.
plugins.author: Stephane Bury

plugins.name: arcana-plugin-upx
plugins.description: Restores executables compressed with UPX (NRV2B/2D/2E and LZMA) for static analysis. It never runs them.
plugins.files: Windows PE32 and PE32+, Linux ELF, by content
plugins.author: Stephane Bury
